title: CSM bdd-tdd suite config namespace
description: Bounded, non-authority presentation settings for the csm-bdd-tdd namespace of csm-skills-config/1. Only spec presentation is configurable; package ownership, spec/test artifact ownership, lifecycle, TDD ordering, credentials, commit/push authorization, and write scope are never granted here. Unknown keys are rejected.

outputStyle.description: Presentation style of generated spec/test designs; never changes package ownership, artifact schemas, or lifecycle.

includeTraceability.description: Whether generated designs render the traceability section; the traceability contract itself stays skill-owned.
